Ebb and Flood.name: Ebb and Flood
Ebb and Flood.description: The user lays both hands in a flood, a river or a burst reservoir and takes hold of the whole body of water across a city block for the rest of the scene. They can raise it into walls, drain streets dry, lift everyone caught in it to the surface and carry them to a safe point, or pull the enemies they choose to their knees and hold them there until each breaks free with a hard effort or the user lets go. Strain: severe.
